pairsWith.noteUz: Sifat/ravish ro'yxatdan tanlash va Past Continuous mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 4-UNIT MAShQLAR (22-bet, PDF 21). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '4'.

CHAP USTUN:
3) 'Fill in the gaps with the correct adjective or adverb from the list below, as in the example.' Ro'yxat: expensive, politely, relieved, early, terrified, awful, quietly, cheerfully, incredibly, young. SURAT: uyqusiragan qizcha stolda. 1 "Why do I have to wake up so ...... every morning?" 2 We were all very ...... when the plane landed safely. 3 He sat ...... at his desk and finished his homework. 4 Why did you buy such a(n) ...... rucksack? I told you to use mine. 5 He speaks Spanish ...... well. 6 When Tracey saw her son walk towards the cliff, she was ...... he would fall. 7 "Can I use your telephone, please," she asked ...... . 8 The weather was ...... . It rained for days. 9 When my grandmother was ......, she wanted to be an opera singer. 10 They clapped ...... when their team won the match.
'Past Continuous':
4) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense (past simple, past continuous), then choose the correct linking word to complete the sentences, as in the example.' 1 Pat was reading (read) a magazine when/while her son was watching (watch) TV. 2 The children ...... (play) in the park and/when it ...... (start) to rain. 3 Ed ...... (wear) his new leather jacket when/while he ...... (spill) oil on it. 4 I ...... (hurt) my leg and/as I ...... (run) down the street. 5 Tom ...... (clean) the swimming pool when/and Lily ...... (paint) the fence.

O'NG USTUN:
6 When/While I ...... (go) to Sally's house I ...... (find) nobody there. 7 Victoria ...... (cut) her finger as/and she ...... (slice) the cheese.
5) 'This is a picture of the Smiths' farm. Look at what they were doing at 5 o'clock yesterday afternoon. Then use the prompts to ask and answer questions, as in the example.' pick tomatoes - feed the chickens - repair the tractor - water the plants - play with the dog. SURATLAR: Elaine - pomidor teryapti; Sally & Bob - tovuq boqishyapti; Jim - gullarni sug'oryapti; Bill - traktor tuzatyapti; Ann - it bilan o'ynayapti. 1 Bill/pick tomatoes? A: Was Bill picking tomatoes? B: No, he wasn't. He was repairing the tractor. 2 Elaine/play with the dog? 3 Sally & Bob/water the plants? 4 Jim/repair the tractor? 5 Ann/feed the chickens?
6) 'Underline the correct item.' 1 Mary was walking to work when/as she saw a car accident. 2 Before/As Laura was running through the park, it started to rain heavily. 3 Nora was ironing after/while Jim was cooking dinner. 4 Sue was having a bath as/when the doorbell rang. 5 The fire alarm went off after/when the employees were having a meeting.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '22'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct adjective or adverb from the list below, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri sifat yoki ravish bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXATDAN SIFAT / RAVISh.

  1 wake up so EARLY (ravish)
  2 very RELIEVED (sifat - his)
  3 sat QUIETLY (ravish)
  4 such an EXPENSIVE rucksack
    (sifat - ot oldida)
  5 INCREDIBLY well (ravish -
    ravishni kuchaytiradi)
  6 was TERRIFIED (sifat - his)
  7 asked POLITELY (ravish)
  8 was AWFUL (sifat - to be)
  9 was YOUNG (sifat - to be)
  10 clapped CHEERFULLY (ravish)


⚠ 'RELIEVED':

  = yengil tortgan.


⚠ 'A CLIFF':

  = jarlik, qoya.


⚠ 'TO CLAP':

  = qarsak chalmoq.

items.sentence: "Why do I have to wake up so ___ every morning?"
items.uz: "Nega har kuni ertalab bunchalik erta turishim kerak?"

items.sentence: We were all very ___ when the plane landed safely.
items.uz: Samolyot xavfsiz qo'nganda hammamiz yengil tortdik.

items.sentence: He sat ___ at his desk and finished his homework.
items.uz: U stolida jimgina o'tirib uy vazifasini tugatdi.

items.sentence: Why did you buy such a(n) ___ rucksack? I told you to use mine.
items.uz: Nega bunchalik qimmat ryukzak sotib olding? Menikini ishlat degan edim.

items.sentence: When Tracey saw her son walk towards the cliff, she was ___ he would fall.
items.uz: Treysi o'g'li jarlik tomon yurganini ko'rganda, u yiqilib tushadi deb qo'rqib ketdi.

items.sentence: "Can I use your telephone, please," she asked ___.
items.uz: "Telefoningizdan foydalansam bo'ladimi?" deb muloyimlik bilan so'radi u.

items.sentence: The weather was ___. It rained for days.
items.uz: Ob-havo dahshatli edi. Kunlab yomg'ir yog'di.

items.sentence: When my grandmother was ___, she wanted to be an opera singer.
items.uz: Buvim yoshligida opera qo'shiqchisi bo'lishni xohlagan.

items.sentence: They clapped ___ when their team won the match.
items.uz: Jamoalari o'yinda g'alaba qozonganda ular quvnoq qarsak chalishdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense (past simple, past continuous), then choose the correct linking word to complete the sentences, as in the example. Example: Pat was reading (read) a magazine when/WHILE her son was watching (watch) TV.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga (past simple, past continuous) qo'ying, so'ng gapni to'ldirish uchun to'g'ri bog'lovchini tanlang, namunadagidek. Namuna: Pat was reading (read) a magazine when/WHILE her son was watching (watch) TV.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI HARAKAT - QAYSI ZAMON, QAYSI
  BOG'LOVChI?

  Ikkala uzun (bir vaqtda) →
    Continuous + WHILE + Continuous
  Uzun + qisqa uzilish →
    Continuous + WHEN + Simple
  Qisqa + uzun →
    Simple + AS/WHILE + Continuous

  1 was reading WHILE was watching
    (NAMUNA)
  2 were playing WHEN started
  3 was wearing WHEN spilled
  4 hurt AS was running
  5 was cleaning WHILE was
    painting ('when' ham mumkin;
    'and' emas)
  6 WHEN went ... found (ikkala
    qisqa - Simple; 'While' emas)
  7 cut AS was slicing


⚠ 'TO SPILL':

  = to'kib yubormoq.


⚠ 'TO SLICE':

  = bo'laklab kesmoq.

items.textEn: Pat ___ (read) a magazine when/while her son ___ (watch) TV.
items.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA. Ikki uzun harakat bir vaqtda → while.

items.textEn: The children ___ (play) in the park and/when it ___ (start) to rain.
Ed ___ (wear) his new leather jacket when/while he ___ (spill) oil on it.
I ___ (hurt) my leg and/as I ___ (run) down the street.
Tom ___ (clean) the swimming pool when/and Lily ___ (paint) the fence.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ikki uzun harakat; 'and' bog'lovchi emas → when (while ma'nosida).

items.textEn: When/While I ___ (go) to Sally's house I ___ (find) nobody there.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Bordim - topmadim: ikkala qisqa → Simple, When.

items.textEn: Victoria ___ (cut) her finger as/and she ___ (slice) the cheese.

exercises.instructionEn: This is a picture of the Smiths' farm. Look at what they were doing at 5 o'clock yesterday afternoon. Then use the prompts to ask and answer questions, as in the example. Pictures: Elaine - picking tomatoes; Sally & Bob - feeding the chickens; Jim - watering the plants; Bill - repairing the tractor; Ann - playing with the dog. 1 Bill/pick tomatoes? 2 Elaine/play with the dog? 3 Sally & Bob/water the plants? 4 Jim/repair the tractor? 5 Ann/feed the chickens?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu Smitlar fermasining surati. Kecha soat 5 da ular nima qilayotganiga qarang. So'ng ko'rsatmalar bilan savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. Suratlar: Eleyn - pomidor teryapti; Salli va Bob - tovuq boqishyapti; Jim - gullarni sug'oryapti; Bill - traktor tuzatyapti; Enn - it bilan o'ynayapti. 1 Bill/pick tomatoes? 2 Elaine/play with the dog? 3 Sally & Bob/water the plants? 4 Jim/repair the tractor? 5 Ann/feed the chickens?
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST CONTINUOUS - SAVOL, INKOR,
  TASDIQ.

  A: Was/Were + kim + V-ing?
  B: No, ... wasn't/weren't. ...
     was/were + V-ing (suratdagi
     haqiqiy ish).

  Hamma savol noto'g'ri → hamma
  javob 'No'.

  Sally & Bob → WERE (ko'plik).


⚠ 'TO FEED THE CHICKENS':

  = tovuqlarni boqmoq.


⚠ 'TO REPAIR':

  = tuzatmoq.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A: Was Bill picking tomatoes? B: No, he wasn't. He was repairing the tractor.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 A: Bill pomidor terayotganmidi? B: Yo'q. U traktor tuzatayotgan edi.
modelAnswers: 1 A: Was Bill picking tomatoes? B: No, he wasn't. He was repairing the tractor.
2 A: Was Elaine playing with the dog? B: No, she wasn't. She was picking tomatoes.
3 A: Were Sally and Bob watering the plants? B: No, they weren't. They were feeding the chickens.
4 A: Was Jim repairing the tractor? B: No, he wasn't. He was watering the plants.
5 A: Was Ann feeding the chickens? B: No, she wasn't. She was playing with the dog.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Bill pomidor terayotganmidi? - Yo'q. U traktor tuzatayotgan edi. (NAMUNA)
2 Eleyn it bilan o'ynayotganmidi? - Yo'q. U pomidor terayotgan edi.
3 Salli va Bob gullarni sug'orayotganmidi? - Yo'q. Ular tovuq boqayotgan edi. (were)
4 Jim traktor tuzatayotganmidi? - Yo'q. U gullarni sug'orayotgan edi.
5 Enn tovuq boqayotganmidi? - Yo'q. U it bilan o'ynayotgan edi.

exercises.explanationUz:
BOG'LOVChILAR: WHEN / AS / WHILE /
  BEFORE / AFTER.

  1 was walking WHEN she saw (uzun
    + qisqa → when)
  2 AS Laura was running, it
    started (as + Continuous)
  3 was ironing WHILE Jim was
    cooking (ikki uzun → while)
  4 was having a bath WHEN the
    doorbell rang (qisqa → when)
  5 went off WHEN the employees
    were having (uzun harakat
    paytida → when)

  ⚠ before/after - ketma-ketlik,
  bir vaqtdalik emas.


⚠ 'THE FIRE ALARM WENT OFF':

  = yong'in signali ishga tushdi.


⚠ 'THE DOORBELL':

  = eshik qo'ng'irog'i.

items.textEn: Mary was walking to work when/as she saw a car accident.
items.uz: Meri ishga piyoda ketayotganda avtohalokatni ko'rdi.

items.textEn: Before/As Laura was running through the park, it started to rain heavily.
items.uz: Laura park bo'ylab yugurayotganda qattiq yomg'ir boshlandi.

items.textEn: Nora was ironing after/while Jim was cooking dinner.
items.uz: Nora dazmol qilayotganda Jim ovqat pishirayotgan edi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ikki uzun harakat bir vaqtda → while.

items.textEn: Sue was having a bath as/when the doorbell rang.
The fire alarm went off after/when the employees were having a meeting.
items.uz: Xodimlar yig'ilish o'tkazayotganda yong'in signali ishga tushdi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Uzun harakat paytida → when (after - keyin, mos emas).

patterns.formula: KIM + was + V-ing + when + KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: Sue was having a bath when the doorbell rang.

patterns.formula: KIM + was + V-ing + while + KIM + was + V-ing
patterns.exampleEn: Nora was ironing while Jim was cooking dinner.
patterns.exampleUz: Nora dazmol qilayotganda Jim ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

patterns.formula: As + KIM + was + V-ing, KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: As Laura was running through the park, it started to rain.
patterns.exampleUz: Laura park bo'ylab yugurayotganda yomg'ir boshlandi.

patterns.formula: Was + KIM + V-ing? — No, ... wasn't. ... was + V-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: Was Bill picking tomatoes? — No, he wasn't. He was repairing the tractor.
patterns.exampleUz: Bill pomidor terayotganmidi? — Yo'q. U traktor tuzatayotgan edi.
